tool.name: C. diphtheriae typing
tool.description: tox detection, tox allele and MLST from assemblies

param.name: input
param.label: Assembly FASTA
param.help: One or more assemblies, or a collection. Sample names are taken from the dataset/element names.

param.name: mlst_min_identity
param.label: MLST minimum identity for a novel-allele call (%)

param.name: mlst_min_coverage
param.label: MLST minimum coverage for a novel-allele call (%)

tool.help:
**What it does**
Types *Corynebacterium diphtheriae* genome assemblies against the BIGSdb-Pasteur database:
- **tox** gene detection and **tox allele** assignment - **7-gene MLST** sequence type (ST) - records the **database version** used for every result
**Output columns**
============ ============================================================== Sample dataset / collection element name tox_gene ``tox`` | ``novel tox allele`` | ``review`` | ``tox not present`` tox_allele allele number; ``~N`` novel (closest N); ``?N`` partial; ``NA`` ST sequence type; ``novel`` (new allele combination); ``NA`` mlst_profile per-locus calls, e.g. ``atpA(1);dnaE(2);...`` Identity % identity of the best tox hit Coverage % of the tox allele covered by the best hit db_version e.g. ``Pasteur_2026-10`` notes QC flags and reasons for review ============ ==============================================================
**tox calling rules**
- ``tox``: exact match (100% identity, 100% coverage) to a known allele - ``novel tox allele``: identity ≥ 99% and coverage ≥ 95%, not exact - ``review``: a tox-like hit that fails thresholds (often a contig break) - never reported as absent - ``tox not present``: no hit above 30% coverage
**Important:** detection of the *tox* gene does not prove toxin production. Non-toxigenic *tox*-bearing (NTTB) strains exist; toxigenicity must be confirmed phenotypically (e.g. modified Elek test) per your laboratory's procedures.
